description: Wait on one agent run and follow what its agent does, instead of polling get_agent_run. The call returns when the run ends, when its mission moves to another stage, or after maxSeconds. While it waits, each agent event (a thought, a tool call, a plan update, an error) is sent as a progress notification when the request has a progress token. The result has the status of the run, the stage of its mission, ended, the reason it returned, the last 20 events and a cursor. When the run is still running, call it again with since set to the cursor. A run that already ended returns at once. If your client ends a call after 60 seconds, set maxSeconds below that.

maxSeconds.description: The longest time to wait, in seconds (default 300, at most 600)

sandboxId.description: Agent run id: the run's sandbox id, from list_agent_runs or get_mission

since.description: The cursor from an earlier result. Only the events after it are sent

name: watch_agent_run

cursor.description: The id of the last event. Give it as since to continue

ended.description: True when the run is no longer running

events.description: The last 20 events at most, oldest first

at.description: When the agent emitted it, in epoch milliseconds

hint.description: What to do next, when the run is still running

reason.description: Why the call returned: the run ended, its mission moved to another stage, or maxSeconds passed

stage.description: The stage of the run's mission when the call returned

status.description: The status of the run when the call returned

title: Watch an agent run
